No final numbers, no letters. Each mid has a `use` ("Use it for") and a `why` ("Why this"): text by Tony, Oct 23 (tooltip authoring rules).

mid.use: New speed when the path around gets smaller or bigger. Orbits, a skater pulling arms in, a ball on a string, anything that goes around.
mid.why: Spin (m·v·r) stays the same. Smaller r, so bigger v.

mid.use: Energy of anything that moves. Cars, balls, people.
mid.why: Two people move. ½mv² + ½mv², one for each.

items.title: Q11 Q4(d): new speeds of the astronauts

mid.use: Spin of things going around a center. Orbits, a ball on a string, people spinning on a rope.
mid.why: Two people spin. mvr for one + mvr for the other.

mid.tex: m v_1 r_1 = m v_2 r_2
mid.use: Before vs after, when nothing outside pushes or twists. A skater pulls arms in, astronauts pull a rope.
mid.why: Spin before = spin after. Pulling inward does not twist.

items.title: Q11 Q1(c): acceleration of the counterweight

mid.use: How hard a pull twists something that turns. A pulley, a wrench, a door, a wheel.
mid.why: The hanging weight pulls with mg. It pulls at the rim, R from the center. Twist = pull × distance.

mid.use: Total spin when some parts slide and some parts turn. A weight on a rope + a pulley.
mid.why: Weight: m·v·R. Wheel: I·ω, with I = MR² and ω = v/R. Add both.

mid.use: How fast speed changes. Anything that speeds up or slows down.
mid.why: Twist = change in spin each second. Spin has v in it, so twist tells you how fast v changes. That is a.

items.title: Q11 Q5: minimum ball speed to swing over the top

mid.use: Spin of a thing moving in a line, around a pivot. A ball hits a door, a bullet hits a stick.
mid.why: The ball hits ℓ from the pivot. Spin = m × v × distance.

mid.use: How hard it is to spin parts stuck together. Stick + ball, door + person, rod + clay.
mid.why: Rod turning about its end: ⅓Mℓ². Ball at the far end: mℓ². Stuck together, so add.

mid.use: Energy to lift things up. Stairs, swings, a stick going over the top.
mid.why: Each part lifts by its own height. Stick middle: up ℓ. Ball at the end: up 2ℓ. Add both.
